item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 15/Mar/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a dry northeast monsoon, the weather will be generally fine over Guangdong today and tomorrow. The temperature difference between day and night will be rather large over inland areas. With the monsoon moderating progressively early to midweek this week, temperatures will rise and the weather will become humid over southern China gradually. An easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of southern China in the latter part of this week.
